name: Pushover
author: Mishkin Faustini
description: Pushover pushes as native desktop notifications, plus a bar widget with unread count and recent-message history. Uses Pushover's Open Client API, so every push that reaches the phone reaches this machine.

barWidget.description: Unread count in the bar, recent pushes in the panel, emergency acknowledgement without reaching for the phone.
